column_groups.label: FineWeb-Edu validation
column_groups.description: Next-token prediction on held-out FineWeb-Edu text. Lower is better. Compare loss and perplexity only on the same validation split.

column_groups.label: Downstream benchmarks
column_groups.description: HellaSwag normalized completion accuracy and LAMBADA exact final-word accuracy. Higher is better.

notes: Rounded reported results. Stage B uses a different validation split and its val loss/PPL must not be directly compared with Stage C rows. Stage C s1, s2, final (step 31,101, 3.06B tokens) and GPT-2 use the same Stage C val.bin. The final checkpoint has lower FineWeb-Edu validation loss than GPT-2 124M (3.174 vs 3.279), but still trails it on HellaSwag and LAMBADA. Lower FineWeb-Edu validation loss does not establish superior general-purpose capabilities.
